question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) i.e. 'ready.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options: 

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 alert
 quick to notice any unusual and potentially dangerous or difficult circumstances; vigilant. (चेतावनी)
 
 

 fit
 in good health, especially because of regular physical exercise. (उपयुक्त; अच्छे स्वास्थ्य में विशेष रूप से नियमित शारीरिक व्यायाम के कारण)
 
 

 ready
 prepared for something; in a suitable state for an action or situation. (तैयार)
 
 

 fixed
 firmly in position; not movable. (निर्धारित)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Let's look at the sentence: "And only two hours before him to do all this heap of work and get __________ for school."
 
• "Ready" means fully prepared or in a fit state for immediate action. In the context of the passage, Swaminathan had only two hours to complete his work and get prepared for school.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "ready" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 3.

​

Complete passage:__ Swaminathan had a table on which all his things, his coat, cap, slate, ink-bottle, and books, were thrown in a confused (1) heap. He sat on his stool and shut his eyes to (2) recollect what work he had for the day: first of course there was Arithmetic – those five (3) puzzles in Profit and Loss; then there was English – he had to copy down a page from his English lesson and write dictionary meanings of (4) difficult words; and then there was Geography. And only two hours before him to do all this heap of work and get (5) ready for school.
